Change a quantile only where the data in front of you gives a concrete reason the ensemble is likely to have missed or mis-sized, for example: a listing at or next to the middle that drifts daily, so the median will follow it by a computable amount; a listing whose return or exit would move the middle to a known neighbouring price; the record showing actuals falling on one side of the band. Compute the median you expect from the listing prices when you can. Where you have no such reason, return the base numbers unchanged.
